conflictsOfInterest: The founder is the project maintainer; this internal review is not independent external validation.
decisionText: Apruebo la revisión interna de SPEC-014 y SPEC-015 sobre 390fd7b, aceptando el límite del caso positivo de SPEC-015; mantengo pendiente la validación externa y no cierro M2
scope: Internal deterministic operation-subset reduction of verified divergent fixed-patch Git replay evidence.
rationale: The 29 focused tests passed for verified input handling, deterministic subset search, irreducible witnesses, budget exhaustion and supervised timeout. All six evidence input digests match both the public base and the reviewed commit. The twelve-command internal clean-room reproduction passed on ancestor 613b529; subsequent changes through the reviewed commit only packaged governance, reproduction and assurance records.
limits: Positive reduction and minimality paths use a controlled divergent backend; no real all-complete divergent Git fixture established a positive end-to-end reduction.
Minimality is limited to enumerated dependency-closed operation subsets in the bounded fixed-patch tracked-tree domain; no patch-hunk or semantic-effect claim is made.
The clean-room reproduction is internal; independent external validation remains pending.
